title: Independent unlabeled calibration under unseen noise
origin: Prespecified secondary batch32 result in Stage52 motivated this new-seed followup. Stage52 primary FAIL remains unchanged.
primary: 32 independent unlabeled fields from the SAME graph, noise and corruption regime; select minimum average LOO NLPD gate, freeze it for disjoint test observations. New noise is supplied, not estimated. Same corrupt gain and intact noninferiority criterion as Stage52.
scope: Not single-request label-free inference, no reuse across changing regimes, all calibration acquisition and computation are additional cost. No graph is held out from a fitted selector because there is no fitted selector.
statistics: 10 independent graph/input seed blocks, paired t intervals. Other calibration sizes exploratory; do not select size from test results.
